caption: The drawing depicts a brown, wooden sculpture of a deer with segmented body parts, indicated by visible round pins or joints at the neck, shoulders, hips, and legs. The deer has four slender legs and a pointed tail, all of which are connected to the body by circular, hinge-like joints. Its head is elongated, and it has a set of thin, branched antlers rendered in a dark, almost black color. The sculpture is mounted on a dark rectangular base, which appears to be made of wood as well. The overall coloration consists of various shades of brown on the deer, with darker shading used to indicate shadows and contours, and black is used for the base and antlers. The background is a plain off-white.
title: Figure of a Deer
